retrievalProfile.description: A warm-toned, tight facial portrait of a blonde female artist with layered hair, featuring high-contrast white sans-serif and orange script typography in the lower-left corner.
triggerTerms: warm blonde portrait with layered hair
excludeWhen: cool-toned or high-key lighting is requested
minimalist or centered typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly angled portrait of a woman with feathered blonde hair and blue eyes. The lighting is warm and directional, creating soft shadows on the face. The background is dark and indistinct, allowing the subject's hair and face to dominate the frame. Typography is anchored in the bottom left, utilizing a bold, white, condensed sans-serif for the primary name and a smaller, orange, textured script for the secondary title.
coreVisualRelationships: Tight facial crop creates intimacy with the viewer
Warm skin tones contrast against the dark, shadowed background
Feathered hair texture frames the face and leads the eye to the eyes
Typography is tucked into the lower-left quadrant to avoid obscuring facial features
coreInvariants: Warm, golden-hour color temperature on skin and hair
Tight framing that cuts off the top of the head and shoulders
Two-tier typographic hierarchy with contrasting styles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and scaled to fill approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the viewer's right eye, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, and then drops to the typography in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the dark corners and the gaps between hair strands.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and honey blonde (skin and hair)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange (secondary text) and bright white (primary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the center (face) tapering to low value at the edges; moderate saturation in the warm tones.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens in the skin tones
Maintain high contrast between text and background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed geometric sans-serif and organic brush script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, uniform strokes with no serifs
Secondary text mimics hand-painted brush strokes with varying thickness
characterSpecificRedesigns: The apostrophe in the primary text is a simple vertical rectangle
The script text features distressed, textured edges
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, clean industrial sans-serif paired with a raw, organic brush script for a 'polished yet authentic' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, condensed, uppercase sans-serif look
Captures the textured, hand-painted feel of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a tight, warm-toned facial portrait of a woman with layered blonde hair and blue eyes against a dark, shadowed background. Ensure the lighting is soft and golden.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, condensed uppercase sans-serif text in the bottom left corner, stacked in two lines. Below that, add a single line of orange, textured brush-script text with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text white and condensed?
Is the secondary text orange and textured?
Is the portrait crop tight on the face?
Is the lighting warm and golden?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the script font is not a direct copy of a trademarked logo
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not cover the eyes or mouth
Verify the orange text has a visible brush texture
Ensure the white text is perfectly legible against the hair
Confirm the overall color palette is warm and cohesive
recipe.reuseFormula: Tight warm-toned portrait + [Subject Description] + Bottom-left stacked [Bold Sans-Serif] and [Textured Script] typography.
